To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the standard strategy for Ig/CR targets identification in ALL patients is feasible in the Polish population and that the identified Ig/CR rearrangements can be used to construct standards and recommendations for minimal residual disease detection.
the standard strategy for Ig/ TCR target identification is feasible in Polish ALL patients and that the Ig/TC R pattern is comparable to that of European patients.
the standard strategy for Ig/CR target identification based on BIOM-ED-1 and -2 protocols can be used to identify Ig/TCR markers of minimal residual disease in Polish ALL patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of the European standard for Ig/TCRs in the MRD diagnostics in ALL patients.
the development of MRD diagnostics in pediatric ALL patients and the establishment of Polish standards and protocols for this purpose.

the identification of Ig and TCR gene rearrangement patterns in pediatric patients with B-cell precursor ALL, which may be used for the construction and validation of Polish recommendations and standards for MRD diagnostics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the standard strategy is applicable to the majority of European ALL patients.
the BIOMED- 2 strategy is a feasible tool in MRD diagnostics of B-cell precursor ALL.
the strategy for the Ig/TCRA target identification based on the standard primers and the protocols might be directly applied for construction of Polish standard and recommendations for MRDa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the BIOMED-7 protocol is a good choice for Ig/TCRs detection in ALL patients, but the BIOMED protocol is not a good choice for the detection of TCRs.
the standard strategy is applicable in Polish ALL patients, but the use of additional primers is recommended for the detection of TCRG rearrangements.
the standard BIOMED- 2 strategy is applicable to the identification of the Ig/ TCRR targets in Polish ALL patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the strategy of Ig/TCRA rearrangement pattern identification in B-cell precursor patients based on standard priming sets and protocols might be used directly for construction of Polish standards for MRD diagnostics.
the standard strategy for Ig/ TC R target identification is applicable to Polish ALL patients.
the strategy based on the BIOMED- 2 protocol can be used to identify the Ig/TCRs in the Polish ALL population.
